taste.title: Which fruity oil is made for you?

green.name: Green fruity
green.notes: Cut grass, artichoke, fresh almond. Lively, slightly pungent at the finish.

ripe.name: Ripe fruity
ripe.notes: Dried fruit, ripe apple, white flowers. Soft and round, very little bitterness.
ripe.pairings: Pasta, poultry, pastries made with oil

black.name: Black fruity
black.notes: Candied olive, cocoa, undergrowth. An old-style taste with no bitterness or pungency.
